2577-5231-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5231-6763-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

628-4050-7865.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1591-3558-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1591-3558-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.

215-527-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-4785.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

876-2107-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Sunastian Falconer.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Sunastian Falconer.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Sunastian Falconer.
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Sunastian Falconer.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Sunastian Falconer.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Sunastian Falconer from exile by paying {2}.

339-677-5231-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3317-5147-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-5147-5972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-6441-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

483-4681-5170-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4094-5526-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4094-5526-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-1062-2628--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol, Slogurk's first triggered ability, and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Slogurk.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning the cycled land and up to two additional land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Slogurk's ability from step 2, failing to put a counter on it since it left the battlefield.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-1062-2628--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-3773-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

129-4824-5268.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-4824-5268.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2034-5220-5946.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2034-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers excluding the nontoken creature mentioned above.

When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

513-527-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.

Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4681-4730-5256-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

478-804-2821-4249-4324.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-4249-4324.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
478-804-2821-4249-4324.description:
Animate Candelabra using Workshop Elders.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

198-1651-2585-4824.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
198-1651-2585-4824.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Grim Monolith and Soliton, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Grim Monolith's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.

2034-2397-3089-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar five times by sacrificing five Myrs, adding ten {C}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Myr, returning Myr Battlesphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1339-2034-4772-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

1913-4067-4559.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other artifacts.

Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two artifacts, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.

Repeat.

2510-4934-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4934-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4772-5189.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4772-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Repeat.

802-1741-2649-4615.notablePrerequisites: You control up to four lands that can produce {1}{W/U}{R}{R}.
802-1741-2649-4615.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Cloud of Faeries.
The Cloud of Faeries mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Quasiduplicate from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature triggers, untapping two lands you control.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Cloud of Faeries mutated creature.
The token Cloud of Faeries mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Quasiduplicate from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature triggers, untapping two lands you control.
Resolve a second trigger from step 7, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 7, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 7 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 6, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature token.

937-2749-4591.description:
During your upkeep, activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving Wall of Blood +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
